display.title: Text & Screen
display.text.title: Character Display
display.text.note: Changes display only, does not modify original files. Script conversion applies first, followed by custom rules below.
display.text.rules.order: Longest original text first; equal length follows list order
display.text.rule.duplicate: Duplicate original text: first rule in list applies, this rule will not take effect.
display.visual.title: Screen Filters
display.visual.enable.note: Master switch, also controls color vision assistance; does not reflow chapters
display.visual.enable.label: Enable screen filters
display.visual.invert.label: Invert colors
display.visual.compare.tip: Hold to view original screen, release to restore filters
display.assist.title: Color Vision Assistance
display.assist.note: Shifts confusing colors toward more distinguishable hues. Adjusts display only and does not claim to correct vision.
display.assist.strength.label: Color vision assistance strength
display.assist.preview: Split preview: top row original, bottom row with {mode} assistance
display.assist.grayscaleNote: When grayscale is enabled simultaneously, color contrast is removed and assistance effectiveness decreases.
